function: Learns the base-station multiuser downlink beamformers (holographic surface amplitudes and digital precoder) that maximize the sum spectral efficiency of a holographic MIMO system (p. 1-2).
system: Downlink holographic MIMO base station, 12x12 leaky-wave metasurface antenna elements, 4 RF chains, 4 single-antenna users, 30 GHz; no RIS (p. 2, 5).
method: Gradient-based graph neural network (GGNN) with two closed-form projection modules, permutation-equivariant; unsupervised training with negative sum-rate loss, Adam (p. 3-5).
data_channel: Simulated multipath channel (one LoS, one NLoS path per user, random angles); 500,000 training and 10,000 test samples; 3GPP CDL-D also evaluated (p. 5).
test_conditions: Trained with K=6, NRF=10, tested with K=4 to 8; trained with random phase patterns and Nx mostly up to 12, tested with Nx=10 to 14 (p. 5-6).
baselines: Learned: DecGNN, MDGNN, TNN (transformer), VAGNN (ablation without gradient-based updates). Non-learned: alternating optimization (AO); WMMSE fully digital upper bound (p. 5).
metrics: Achievable spectral efficiency; SE ratio to AO for generalization; inference latency; training samples, time, and space (p. 5-6).
complexity: FLOPs formula and Big-O order, linear in Nt versus cubic for AO (p. 4); inference latency 20.36 ms versus 59.23 s for AO (p. 6).
q1_support: p. 5: "we also evaluate the schemes under the 3GPP Clustered Delay Line (CDL)-D channel model". Main results use a custom two-path channel; the paper does not say whether training also used CDL-D data.
q2_support: p. 5: "all methods are trained with NRF = 10 and K = 6, and tested with K ranging from 4 to 8". Also tests other antenna counts after random-phase-pattern training (p. 6).
q3_support: p. 1: "achieves higher SE with lower inference latency than the AO baseline"; p. 5: "it improves the SE by 5.1%–22.8% over MDGNN". Non-learned AO and earlier learned MDGNN, DecGNN, TNN, all on SE.
q4_support: p. 4: "Inference Complexity in Order of Magnitude of FLOPs"; p. 6: "Table II compares the inference and training complexity". FLOPs, Big-O order and measured latency are reported.
q5_support: p. 5: "A total of 500,000 samples are used for training and another 10,000 for testing". Simulated data; no link to code or data anywhere in the paper, and CDL-D is a channel model, not a released dataset.
notes: PDF is the arXiv v4 preprint (arXiv:2504.19522v4, 13 Jul 2026), not verified against the DOI title. ris=0 because the holographic surface is the BS transmit antenna (leaky-wave metasurface), not a reflecting RIS; reviewer to confirm. q1 rests only on the CDL-D experiment of Fig. 3(d), p. 5. VAGNN is an ablation, so DecGNN, MDGNN and TNN are the learned baselines for q3.
